name: QuillBot
tagline: Paraphrasing, grammar, and summarizing suite used by 35M+ writers.
description: QuillBot is a writing suite centered on paraphrasing, grammar checking, and summarizing, with added tools for citation, plagiarism and AI detection, and translation. It runs on the web, as browser extensions and a Word add-in, and on desktop and mobile, widely used by students and professionals.
insight: Founded in 2017 by three UIUC computer-science students; acquired by Course Hero (now Learneo) in August 2021.

modelSupport.notes: Combines proprietary paraphrasing models with third-party LLM features.

edge: A Learneo (ex-Course Hero) suite centered on paraphrasing — tooling skews toward students, sitting beside Course Hero and Scribbr.
